text_block_list.text: So I did it... I actually beat Sis!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Well done, Brian. You're extraordinary.
You
outran reason and logic.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I never imagined you'd compete in the

Takarazuka Kinen in your classic year.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And the raw talent you displayed tells
me you still
have the potential for
further growth.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's truly frightening to think of where
you'll be by
the end of summer. It seems
that you're out ahead
of me for good.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...But this isn't the end, you know.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I want to race at least one more time. If
it's as
heart-pounding as today, then...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This is the Twinkle Series, where every
racer
pushes forward and aims for the
top.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Let's race again. Next time, I'll be the
one
showing you my back!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Deal. I'll beat you next time too!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
